name: Himal Chilbo IT three-worker affiliation and repatriation context

attribution.legal_posture: UN Panel reporting; some claims reproduce Member State information and remain outside criminal adjudication.

statements: A footnote records that Nepal informed the Panel about three IT workers affiliated with Himal Chilbo IT; annex 34 places this within Nepal-reported repatriations.
